edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $450,000, payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices, plus eligibility to participate in the Company's generally available benefit plans, subject to the terms of those plans.
edits.name: Compensation

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Executive's employment is terminated by the Company without Cause, the Executive shall receive a severance payment equal to 12 months of Base Salary, subject to the Executive's execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims. The release shall provide the Executive with 21 days to consider the release and, following execution, 7 days to revoke the release, and the release shall not become effective until the expiration of such revocation period.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. The Executive shall comply with customary confidentiality and invention assignment obligations in favor of the Company. During employment and for 12 months following the Executive's termination of employment, the Executive shall not, directly or indirectly, solicit for employment any employee of the Company with whom the Executive had material business contact during the 12 months preceding termination, or knowingly induce any such employee to terminate employment with the Company; provided that general solicitations not specifically targeted at Company employees shall not violate this Section.
edits.name: Restrictive Covenants
